speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. Welcome to your consultation; please note that while we will review any history provided, I need to ask you specific questions to understand your condition. Since you are here as a newborn, I will need your mother to answer on your behalf. How old are you in days, and have you been feeding well since birth?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Tetanus. The mother had no prenatal care or immunizations, and the newborn presents with classic risk factors for tetanus (term delivery, no maternal tetanus toxoid history).
